# Meet, Greet, &amp; Eat with your Board of Trustees

Tue, Jul 29 2025, 6 - 7:30pm

Add to your calendar

[Google](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/r/eventedit?dates=20250729T180000%2F20250729T193000&text=Meet%2C%20Greet%2C%20&Eat_with_your_Board_of_Trustees=&details=Join%20the%20Board%20of%20Trustees%20for%20food%20and%20conversation%21%20Meet%2C%20Greet%2C%20and%20Eat%20events%20will%20be%20hosted%20in%20three%20neighborhoods%20throughout%20the%20summer%2C%20with%20free%20food%20and%20dessert%20provided.Meet%20your%20neighbors%20and%20chat%20with%20Trustees%21&nbsp%3BPlease_be_aware_that_users_will_be_leaving_the_Town_of_Mead_website_by_navigating_to_the_links_provided_on_this_webpage_June_10%3A_North_Creek_Park_-_Crepes_on_WheelsJuly_29%3A_Liberty_Ranch_Park_-_Pala_NeroAug_26%3A_Lakeside_Canyon_Park_-_Lulu%27s_Taters6-7%3A30_p_m_%2C_full_html_standard_wysiwyg_buttons%2C_Join_the_Board_of_Trustees_for_food_and_conversation%21_Meet%2C_Greet%2C_and_Eat_events_will_be_hosted_in_three_neighborhoods_throughout_the_summer%2C_with_free_food_and_dessert_provided_= "(opens in a new window)")[Outlook (ical)](https://www.townofmead.org/calendar/ical/node/66129/calendar.ics)

[Back to Calendar](https://www.townofmead.org/calendar)

Join the Board of Trustees for food and conversation! Meet, Greet, and Eat events will be hosted in three neighborhoods throughout the summer, with free food and dessert provided.

Meet your neighbors and chat with Trustees! 

**Please be aware that users will be leaving the Town of Mead website by navigating to the links provided on this webpage.**

June 10: North Creek Park - [Crepes on Wheels](https://www.crepes-on-wheels.com "(opens in a new window)")  
July 29: Liberty Ranch Park - [Pala Nero](https://www.facebook.com/palanero "(opens in a new window)")  
Aug 26: Lakeside Canyon Park - [Lulu's Taters](https://lulustaters.com "(opens in a new window)")

6-7:30 p.m.
